{'translation': 'In addition to releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also simultaneously rolled out updated developer betas of these two systems under new build numbers. Here are the details.', 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': 'Updated Builds Released Alongside Public Beta', 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': 'Apple released updated builds of iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 and macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 3 alongside the launch of the first public beta.', 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': 'The updated iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 carries build number 26A5378n.', 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': "It remains unclear why Apple pushed out the updated builds, as there have been no widespread reports of any major issues beforehand. The changes may have been intended to address problems discovered shortly before today's public beta rollout, but Apple has not provided any details.", 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': 'That said, we are digging into the new builds and will report back if we find anything noteworthy.', 'language_hint': 'en'}

{'translation': 'Have you spotted any new features in the updated builds? Let us know in the comments.', 'language_hint': 'en'}
